# Tabs

Tabs, segmented control, or filter bar, one component, animated indicator.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Tabs` · Surfaces

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Tabs items={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Tabs" items="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Tabs / segmented control / filter bar with an animated active indicator. Roving tabindex, arrow keys (mirrored in RTL), Home/End, per-item disabled.

## Props (TabsProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` * | `TabItem[]` |  |
| `value` | `string` | Controlled value. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | Uncontrolled initial value. |
| `onChange` | `(value: string) => void` |  |
| `variant` | `'underline' \| 'segmented' \| 'pills'` | underline (nav), segmented (sliding pill in a trough), pills (filter bar). @default "underline" |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | @default "md" |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | Equal-width tabs across the container. @default false |
| `label` | `string` | aria-label for the tablist. |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'onChange'>._
